condition.label: Dual antiplatelet therapy after drug-eluting stent — fixed 12-month course
condition.plain_english: He has a small metal tube holding a heart artery open, and two blood-thinning tablets stop it clotting shut while it heals over.

prompts.en: Did he take both blood-thinning tablets today?
prompts.zh-Hant: 佢今日有冇食晒兩種薄血藥？

schedule.event: Any clinician, dentist, pharmacist or surgeon says to stop or pause the blood thinners.

prompts.en: Has any doctor, dentist or pharmacist told him to stop or pause the blood thinners?
prompts.zh-Hant: 有冇任何醫生、牙醫或者藥劑師叫佢停薄血藥？

prompts.en: Who told him to stop, and for what procedure?
prompts.zh-Hant: 邊個叫佢停？做咩手術或者程序？

observations.normalisation_hint: Free text. Never used to decide an escalation; carried as evidence only.

schedule.event: Any booked dental work, endoscopy, surgery or biopsy.

prompts.en: Has he booked any dental work, scope, biopsy or operation?
prompts.zh-Hant: 佢有冇約咗脷科、內窺鏡、抽組織或者做手術？

rules.why: Premature discontinuation is the leading independent predictor of stent thrombosis, and it usually arrives as instruction from a clinician who does not know a stent is in place.
The decision to pause blood thinners for a procedure belongs to the cardiologist who placed the stent, and it needs to be made before the appointment rather than in the chair.
Early discontinuation raised all-cause mortality from 4.7 percent to 13.4 percent and stent thrombosis from 3.4 percent to 7.6 percent in a long-term follow-up cohort.
Serious bleeding on dual antiplatelet therapy is itself an emergency, and the decision to stop the tablets in that situation is a clinical one made in hospital.

message.ask: Please contact his cardiology team today, before anything is stopped or booked.
message.because: A procedure has been arranged, or a tablet was missed, while the stent is still healing over.
message.if_ignored: The pause gets decided by whoever is nearest, rather than by the doctor who placed the stent.

message.ask: Do not stop the blood thinners. Telephone his cardiology team now and let them decide.
message.because: Someone has advised stopping while he is still inside the course that keeps the stent open.
message.if_ignored: Clotting of a stent kills between nine and forty-five percent of the people it happens to.

message.ask: Call an ambulance or go to the emergency department now.
message.because: There is bleeding that will not stop, or an urgent cardiology contact has gone unanswered.
message.if_ignored: Both bleeding and stent clotting are time-critical, and neither is safe to manage at home.

prohibitions: Never agree that the blood thinners may be stopped, however senior the person advising it. Route the question to cardiology.
Never weigh bleeding risk against clotting risk. That trade-off is a clinical judgement and the agent has no authority over it.
Never tell the patient to take a double dose to catch up.
Never delay the stop-advice escalation for a cooldown period. This rule has no cooldown by design.

sources.citation: Prevention of Premature Discontinuation of Dual Antiplatelet Therapy in Patients With Coronary Artery Stents — AHA/ACC/SCAI/ACS/ADA science advisory.
Prevalence, Predictors, and Long-Term Prognosis of Premature Discontinuation of Oral Antiplatelet Therapy After Drug Eluting Stent Implantation.

outcome_metrics: stop-advice events caught before the dose was skipped
